Chapter 2262 Obtaining the seventeenth-level middle-grade virtual crystal (page 1)
Obtained the seventeenth-level mid-grade virtual crystal (obtained the seventeenth-level mid-grade virtual crystal (page 22)) But just when he was glad that the matter was over, a slender hand gently rested on his shoulder. This hand would have been so beautiful if the shadow power on it had not been so strong that it could not be dissolved. Yang Wanyi thought for a while, they were all in the same village, and the situation of Yang Danzhen's family was indeed too difficult. She was a kind-hearted person, and she could not bear to see such a thing. "Firearms Science is here. The courses arranged in the military academy require one semester of teaching if they are non-majors. How much time do you have for this class? I will reserve the time for you..." Zhang Zhen looked like he was about to start the class and give a lecture. "Yinyin, Mr. Niu said, money is not a problem, as long as we help them run it, we can say how much it is..." Li Jiniang repeated the other party's request with an embarrassed expression. As the supply line and the front were stretched, the Red Cavalry Alliance attacked quickly. The speed gradually began to slow down. After all, one fleet used to defend one star gate, but now it is a fleet defending thousands of star gates. Moreover, from the beginning to now, Chen Yizhi has not used his full strength, but has been fighting Xuan Mingzi. The law does not blame everyone. Therefore, with people's cover, it is almost impossible to completely eliminate them. Waves of quasi-sage-level malice came from all directions, and Cihang was caught off guard and almost suffocated. At this moment, he clearly realized that although the paper figures in front of him had a quasi-sage cultivation level that could easily kill him. After the first confrontation with his confidant, he got a lot of inspiration, and there were still many ways to explore the use of the ghost's ability.
